build_sine_position_embedding: build a PositionEmbeddingSine module with configurable num_pos_feats, temperature, and normalize options for transformer models
build_learned_position_embedding: build a PositionEmbeddingLearned module with trainable row and column embeddings for absolute positional encoding
build_position_encoding_from_args: build a position encoding module from argparse args using build_position_encoding with sine or learned mode
review_PositionEmbeddingSine_forward: review the PositionEmbeddingSine forward method that computes sinusoidal positional encodings from a NestedTensor input
test_PositionEmbeddingLearned_reset_para: test the PositionEmbeddingLearned reset_parameters method that reinitializes row and column embedding weights uniformly
